_how: Votel has no fixed outbound call-ended schema. Build: call_ended trigger (statuses missed, no_answer, voicemail; direction inbound; phone_number = the client's line) -> webhook step (POST, payload_type json, url https://YOUR-N8N/webhook/missed-call) with these data keys. Only {{call.caller_id_number}} and {{call.caller_id_name}} are confirmed Votel variables; status is static because the trigger filter already limits it to missed calls. NOT deployed: do not build this on Ali's own Votel number.
